Maya: Quick shoutout to Pri for saving onboarding this morning 120 — printed 20 badges when the printer queue died. Lifesaver. :pray:
Pri: Haha had to wrestle the printer and the badge laminator. Also found a mystery bag of scones in the kitchen so morale booster.
Liam: Pri is the office MacGyver. Also huge props to Aria for running a crash course for the new hires on our infra in 20 minutes.
Aria: Went through the essentials, dropped links to the cheat sheet in #eng, and answered the rapid-fire q's. New hires were so chill about the chaos.
Noah: Also shoutout to Facilities who reprogrammed the door schedule so contractors didnt get locked out during setup. Smooth.
Facilities: Fixed the door schedule, confirmed access windows, and left a sticky note on the main console. :wrench:
People-Ops: Sending Pri a $25 local cafe voucher and an 'Onboarding Champion' sticker. Aria is getting a kudos shout in the weekly digest.
Pri: Thank you! Coffee + scone on me later. :coffee: :doughnut:
Maya: Can we make a 1-page "emergency badge printing" checklist so this isnt a heroic solo act next time?
Liam: I'll add a short protocol to the onboarding runbook tonight and pin it in #eng-ops.
Office-Bot: Print queue alert: 2026-08-07T08:11:04Z - manual override by Pri; 20 badges printed; laminations completed: 20.
Maya: Tiny acts, huge impact. Big love to the morning rescue crew. :heart:
